human.name: Human
human.description: Versatile inhabitants of Aldenexia, humans are adaptable, thriving in cities like Lumora as members of the Luminar Covenant. Their ambition and resilience make them natural leaders or explorers, seeking the Solstice Aegis to shape the realm's fate.
human.lore: Humans are the backbone of Lumora's villages, often caught between the Luminar Covenant's zeal and The Moribund Order's schemes.

notes: No Specialization: Humans lack unique racial abilities and rely heavily on class skills.
Plain Appearance: Limited cosmetic customization compared to other races.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Graceful and ancient, Elves are attuned to Aldenexia's forests and arcane energies. Often aligned with Wildcallers or Runecasters, they seek to protect the realm's natural balance while wary of the Void's corruption.
elf.lore: Elves guard sacred groves tied to the Solstice Aegis' origin, often clashing with The Moribund Order's Void ambitions.

notes: Fragile: Elves have reduced physical resilience, making them vulnerable in melee combat.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Stout and hardy, Dwarves hail from Aldenexia's mountains, excelling as Lightsword or Lightmenders. Their craftsmanship and devotion to honor align them closely with the Luminar Covenant.
dwarf.lore: Dwarves forge weapons for the Luminar Covenant, believing the Solstice Aegis is a divine artifact.

notes: Slow-Moving: Reduced mobility in combat.
Arcane Resistance: Lower mana pool makes casting challenging.

gnome.name: Gnome
gnome.description: Clever and inventive, Gnomes are tinkerers and scholars who thrive in creating gadgets or studying the Void's mysteries. They often align with Arcanists or Runecasters.
gnome.lore: Gnomes experiment with Void-tainted relics, drawing scrutiny from both the Luminar Covenant and The Moribund Order.

notes: Physically Weak: Significant reduction in martial effectiveness.
Faction Distrust: Perceived as eccentric by local villagers.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Nimble and cheerful, Halflings are agrarian folk from Lumora's outskirts, excelling as Woodstalkers or Shadowblades. Their luck and stealth make them adept at exploration.
halfling.lore: Halflings are beloved by Lumora's villagers but often avoid the larger conflicts surrounding the Solstice Aegis.

notes: Small Frame: Reduced physical durability and striking power.

half_elf.name: Half-Elf
half_elf.description: Born of Human and Elven heritage, Half-Elves blend adaptability with arcane talent. They excel as Troubadours, Wildspeakers, or Woodstalkers, navigating Aldenexia's factions with ease.
half_elf.lore: Half-Elves serve as mediators between Lumora's villagers and Elven enclaves, seeking the Solstice Aegis to prove their worth.

notes: Jack of All Trades: No specialized high-tier bonuses.
Identity Conflict: Societal prejudice results in slightly slower skill growth.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.description: Towering and brutal, Ogres are fearsome warriors from Aldenexia's wilds, often serving as Voidknights or Blademasters. Their strength and toughness make them formidable in combat.
ogre.lore: Ogres are often recruited by The Moribund Order for their raw power, though some seek redemption with the Luminar Covenant.

notes: Lumbering: Large size makes them easy targets.
Arcane Deficiency: Extremely limited magical potential.

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Savage and regenerative, Trolls are primal denizens of Aldenexia's swamps, excelling as Spiritweavers, Blademasters, or  Voidknights. Their resilience makes them hard to kill.
troll.lore: Trolls worship primal deities, shunning the Solstice Aegis as a human relic, and often align with The Moribund Order.

notes: Poor Reputation: Shunned by most civilized settlements.
Clumsy: Difficulty with precise defensive maneuvers.

dark_elf.name: Dark Elf
dark_elf.description: Cunning and ambitious, Dark Elves are masters of dark magic and subterfuge, excelling as Gravecallers, or Shadowblades. They thrive in the shadows of Aldenexia.
dark_elf.lore: Dark Elves are key members of The Moribund Order, seeking the Void's power to rival the Solstice Aegis.

notes: Sunlight Weakness: Regeneration is severely hampered in daylight.
Outcast: Openly shunned as Void-tainted.

half_orc.name: Half-Orc
half_orc.description: Fierce and resilient, Half-Orcs combine Orcish strength with Human adaptability, excelling as Blademasters or Aetherfist. They are often mercenaries in Aldenexia's wars.
half_orc.lore: Half-Orcs roam Aldenexia as outcasts, often hired by The Moribund Order or seeking honor with the Luminar Covenant to overcome prejudice.

notes: Social Stigma: Distrusted by humans due to Orcish heritage.
Limited Magic: Poor aptitude for complex spellcasting.

lizardkin.name: Lizardkin
lizardkin.description: Lizardkin are reptilian humanoids adapted to swamps and marshes. They possess natural armor, can breathe underwater, and have a powerful bite. They are formidable Aetherfists, Spiritweavers, and Gravecallers
lizardkin.lore: Born from the primal essence of Kaerox, they thrive in Aldenexia's swamps while maintaining deep mistrust of the Luminar Covenant.

notes: Cold Blooded Vulnerability: Severely hampered by freezing environments.
Emotional Distance: Difficulty with cooperative social checks.
Sunlight Dependency: Sustained darkness leads to accuracy penalties.

voidknight.name: Voidknight
voidknight.description: A warrior who has forsaken honor for forbidden power, the Voidknight channels necromantic rituals and blood magic to dominate the battlefield.

lightsworn.name: Lightsworn
lightsworn.description: Bound by sacred oaths to the Luminar Covenant, Lightsworn are radiant defenders of Aldenexia, wielding divine magic to protect and smite.

blademaster.name: Blademaster
blademaster.description: Masters of martial strategy, Blademasters are seasoned commanders who thrive in the chaos of war, wielding an arsenal with unmatched precision.

lightmender.name: Lightmender
lightmender.description: Devoted to the gods of Aldenexia, Lightmenders channel divine light to mend flesh, purify curses, and banish the undead.

spiritcaller.name: Spiritweaver
spiritcaller.description: Spiritweavers bridge the mortal and spirit realms, summoning totems that slow enemies, heal allies, or unleash primal fury.

wildspeaker.name: Wildspeaker
wildspeaker.description: Keepers of the wilderness, Wildspeakers wield nature's raw power to restore balance, often shape-shifting into primal beasts.

aetherfist.name: Aetherfist
aetherfist.description: Mystic warriors who hone body and soul to transcend mortal limits, channeling ki to deliver lightning-fast unarmed strikes.

woodstalker.name: Woodstalker
woodstalker.description: The eyes and blades of the wilds, blending archery, swordplay, and nature's magic to track and strike with deadly accuracy.

shadowblade.name: Shadowblade
shadowblade.description: Masters of subterfuge, Shadowblades thrive in the shadows, striking with surgical precision before vanishing without a trace.

troubadour.name: Troubadour
troubadour.description: Charismatic performers who wield music as both weapon and shield, inspiring allies or sowing discord among enemies.

gravecaller.name: Gravecaller
gravecaller.description: Wielders of the forbidden arts of death, raising undead minions and siphoning life from their foes to fuel their spells.

runecaster.name: Runecaster
runecaster.description: Masters of manipulation, bending minds and reality to their will through intricate illusions and psychic assaults.

arcanist.name: Arcanist
arcanist.description: Scholars of the arcane who study ancient tomes to unravel the Void's secrets and unleash devastating, calculated magic.

chaosborn.name: Chaosborn
chaosborn.description: Born with magic in their blood, they cast spells instinctively, unleashing torrents of elemental energy that can reshape battlefields.
